'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Player field '''Chu''' — published as [[Jonny Chu]] (2007 Worlds winner; inventory note). Deck title WYS panic / WPS panic. Line 1 struck/illegible → [[Thrown Back (V)]] inferred for 60. No numbered Objective; starting [[Hoth: Main Power Generators]]; [[Echo Base Operations]] as Effect. Giree Huw → [[Zev Senesca]] (uncertain). Greatest → [[Great Warrior]]. Shield Chrono(V)/We Shall Receive mapped as available.
